help: Write recorded public Hyperliquid events into a Nautilus Parquet data catalog
description: Converts the recorded public L2 snapshots and trades under cache/events/hyperliquid/<symbol> into a NautilusTrader ParquetDataCatalog with explicit gap provenance. Opt-in; the pipeline never runs it.

options.help: Hyperliquid coin whose recorded events are converted, e.g. BTC
decimal digits of the instrument price
decimal digits of the instrument size
Nautilus instrument id (default: the id 'nautilus run' uses, <COIN>-PERP.HYPERLIQUID upper-cased, e.g. KPEPE-PERP.HYPERLIQUID)
catalog directory (default: nautilus/catalog/<symbol> under the data root)
